svg.text: GCP landing zone network: inspection and DMZ
Palo Alto VM-Series, one NIC per VPC. Trust and DMZ share one VPC that spans both regions.
No local default route. Uses the
VPC network · center spoke · one VPC, both regions
Static routes in the trust VPC (firewall stage)
0.0.0.0/0 → Internal LB us-west4 · priority 1000 · no tag
0.0.0.0/0 → Internal LB us-west2 · priority 900 · tag dmz-usw2
The local routes win over the hub-learned 0/0, which stays
suppressed. Losing a firewall: LB health checks. Losing a
region: manual route change (add the untagged usw2 route first).
Internal LB per region is the next
Reference: Palo Alto Networks, VM-Series deployment models on Google Cloud; Google Cloud, NCC route priority and static routes.
